evals.prompt: 生成一张极简风格的黑白产品海报，主体是一只银色耳机，留白充足，输出一张图。
evals.expected_output: Uses gpt-image MCP text-to-image generation with n=1 and the configured default model, downloads the result automatically, and shows the returned absolute local_path without using another image tool.

evals.prompt: 把 C:\images\reference.png 改成未来城市夜景，保留主体构图。
evals.expected_output: Uses gpt-image MCP image editing with the local path and requested edit prompt, downloads the result automatically, and shows the returned absolute local_path.

evals.prompt: 生图服务如果暂时不可用怎么办？请不要改用内置生图 API。
evals.expected_output: Does not fall back to another image tool; reports the configured MCP/API failure clearly.

evals.prompt: 用 gpt-image-2.5 生成一张象牙白背景的小型玉绿色陶瓷机器人。
evals.expected_output: Calls gpt_image_generate with model=gpt-image-2.5; if pending, polls the returned task ID without resubmitting; shows a completed local image or reports the actual provider error.

evals.prompt: 这次请指定 gpt-image-2.5-flare 生成一张极简咖啡杯照片。
evals.expected_output: Calls the same generic gpt_image_generate tool with model=gpt-image-2.5-flare, preserving the explicit choice rather than replacing it with the default gpt-image-2.5 model.
